name: Colorado Industrial Packaging
old_description: We take pride in working to understand our customers specific needs, and designing and delivering solutions that meet packaging, cost, and time requirements. Colorado Industrial Packaging specializes in high-quality box packaging design in Denver, Aurora and Colorado Springs, CO, creating functional and visually appealing solutions tailored to your needs.
about:
Colorado Industrial Packaging operates from Aurora, Colorado, serving the state’s Front Range and surrounding communities. The company does not disclose its founding year or original founders in its public materials, and no ownership designation such as family‑, veteran‑, or woman‑owned is stated. It positions itself as a packaging corporation and design company focused on durability, branding, and cost‑efficiency for businesses across the region.

CIP manufactures custom packaging solutions including corrugated boxes, foam inserts, and wood crates, supported by a short‑run manufacturing line that allows lower startup costs and reduced minimum orders. The company maintains an in‑house engineering and design team that follows a 7‑Step Design Process for applications ranging from fighter‑jet seats to semiconductor equipment. It also stocks more than 15,000 packaging supply items—boxes, foam, bubble wrap, mailers, tape, labels, stretch wrap, and strapping—with free shipping and delivery offered on stock orders.

The company serves a diverse industrial base: aerospace and defense (including fighter‑jet seating), semiconductor equipment manufacturers, medical device makers, electronics producers, and general manufacturing. It also supports retail, e‑commerce, food and beverage, and pharmaceutical businesses that require custom branded boxes, protective packaging, or retail‑ready presentation.

CIP emphasizes speed and flexibility, claiming up to three times faster turnaround than competitors thanks to its short‑run capabilities. A 30‑day upgrade promise guarantees cost‑effective designs without sacrificing quality, while engineering expertise helps clients reduce material usage and adopt eco‑friendly alternatives. The firm highlights personalized, relationally‑driven service and a consultative approach that begins with a free packaging consultation.
